integrity.direct_exhaustive_scope: all path orientations up to five vertices over F_2 and three vertices over F_3 (actual multiplication), additional polynomial checks through six and five vertices, and small multigraphs
integrity.proof_type: explicit weighted-subgraph inequality, strict extremizer analysis, transfer-matrix spectral calculations

scientific_limitations: The comparison is restricted to orientations of finite loopless bipartite multigraphs and to both extrema on simple paths. The count lemma is not novel in itself: an earlier full right-annihilator spectrum formula determines all quiver zero-product counts. A general unpublished extremal theorem could still imply the new optimization and spectral claims. Fixed finite-field order is essential to path asymptotics; exhaustive computation checks only small prime fields.
title: Sharp orientation extremizers for zero-product probabilities in radical-square-zero quiver algebras
